verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs say users can annotate outputs and gather feedback using annotation queues or inline annotation, and they list human review as an evaluator type, which covers the core of routing outputs to humans for review and labeling. Workflow rules suggest automated routing, but the docs never explicitly tie rules to queues. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how outputs are routed into queues (e.g. rule-based or filter-driven routing), queue configuration and labeling rubric details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
